BATTLEFIELD (2025) is an upcoming first-person shooter, developed by DICE and published by Electronic Arts. The thirteenth main installment in the Battlefield series, it was teasered in february 3rd, 2025 in presentation of BATTLEFIELD LABS. Game will have a multiplayer along with single-player campaign unlike previous Battlefield 2042.
Synopsis
Battlefield (2025) takes place at the year 2027, where unnamed enemy starts fight NATO. It's unclear if it's intraquel between Battlefield 4 and Battlefield 2042, or an independent universe.
Development
The game is developed by series developer DICE in Sweden, with Ripple Effect Studios, Motive Studio, and Criterion Games assisting development. The studios has formed as they claim Battlefield Studios.
Marketing
On February 3rd, 2025 the first video about the upcoming game in series is posted on official Battlefield series YouTube chanel named "Introducing Battlefield Labs | Battlefield Studios". In video shown what part in development takes every studio, presentation of "Battlefield Labs"(a system where players can test game and report in game malfunctions) and "pre-alpha" gameplay where were shown modern setting(M1 Abrams tank and soldiers in modern equipment) and levolution
